license.notes: The repository item page states no reuse licence, so the chapter treats the article as all rights reserved and uses it for citation only, without quotation or reproduction.

notes: The 南島路 article discusses the 東征傳 voyage sequence and the island identifications; it explicitly equates 益救島 with 屋久島 and treats 阿児奈波島 as 沖縄島. It also records the scholarly debate about whether the day sequence can be read as written, which the chapter preserves as a dispute rather than resolving.
